description: This file is a FastAPI application that provides REST API endpoints for managing Robot Framework tests, including uploading, retrieving, deleting, and running tests, as well as querying test runs and results.

methods.name: None startup()
methods.description: Initializes the database connection pool on application startup.

methods.name: dict _serialize_row_timestamps(row: dict)
methods.description: Converts datetime objects in a database row to ISO format strings and ensures 'tags' is parsed from JSON if stored as string.

methods.name: list list_tests()
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all uploaded tests with metadata.

methods.name: None _put_minio_object(key: str, content: bytes, content_type: str = "text/plain")
methods.description: Uploads a file to MinIO storage, raising HTTPException on failure.

methods.name: dict upload_test( file: UploadFile = File(...), name: str = Form(...), description: str = Form(...) )
methods.description: Handles uploading a Robot Framework test file, stores it in MinIO, and creates a database record.

methods.name: dict get_test(test_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves metadata and test cases for a stored test from database and MinIO.

methods.name: dict delete_test(test_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes a test record and removes its associated file from MinIO.

methods.name: dict list_cases(test_id: str)
methods.description: Returns test case names extracted from a stored Robot Framework test file.

methods.name: dict get_test_schema(test_id: str)
methods.description: Provides declared variables, usage, and a simple JSON Schema for a specific test for UI validation.

methods.name: list_all_runs( status: Optional[str] = Query(None), since: Optional[str] = Query(None), tags: Optional[str] = Query(None), )
methods.description: Lists all test runs with optional filtering by status, date, and tags, including test results.

methods.name: list list_runs( test_id: str, status: Optional[str] = Query(None), since: Optional[str] = Query(None), tags: Optional[str] = Query(None), )
methods.description: Lists runs for a specific test with filtering options.

methods.name: run_test(test_id: str, payload: schemas.RunCreateRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks)
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous full test run, fetching test content from MinIO, and queues execution.

methods.name: get_test_case_required_schema(test_id: str, case_name: str)
methods.description: Returns required variables for a specific test case, derived from declared and usage info.

methods.name: dict queue_test(test_id: str, payload: schemas.RunCreateRequest)
methods.description: Queues a test run without starting execution, with variable validation.

methods.name: dict start_queued_run(run_id: str, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks)
methods.description: Transitions a queued run to active status by fetching stored run info and scheduling execution.

methods.name: list list_queued_runs(limit: int = 100)
methods.description: Lists queued runs, most recent first.

methods.name: dict get_run(run_id: str)
methods.description: Returns detailed information and results for a specified run.

ctags.name: _put_minio_object
ctags.pattern: /^def _put_minio_object(key: str, content: bytes, content_type: str = "text\/plain") -> None:$/

ctags.name: list_all_runs
ctags.signature: ( status: Optional[str] = Query(None), since: Optional[str] = Query(None), tags: Optional[str] = Query(None), )

ctags.name: list_runs
ctags.signature: ( test_id: str, status: Optional[str] = Query(None), since: Optional[str] = Query(None), tags: Optional[str] = Query(None), )

ctags.name: run_test
ctags.pattern: /^def run_test(test_id: str, payload: schemas.RunCreateRequest, background_tasks: BackgroundTasks)/

ctags.name: upload_test
ctags.signature: ( file: UploadFile = File(...), name: str = Form(...), description: str = Form(...) )
